copilot.why: The doctor has said out loud they may cancel or are comparing platforms. 36% of these churn against 6.6% baseline — the strongest signal in the data.
copilot.ask: get them on a call today, with their own numbers in front of you
copilot.instead:
DO NOT send a WhatsApp. A templated message to a doctor who just threatened to leave reads as exactly what it is.

Call today. Before you dial, have these three things:
  1. Their bookings: 15 last month, 15 on average. Median for ginecología in Mérida is 12.
  2. What they actually said, on 10 Aug: “Dice que si este mes no mejora el número de citas, cancela. Lo agendé para revisión en 10 días.”
  3. One thing you will change this week, named, with a date.

Do not promise more patients. Promise the specific fix and a follow-up date.
